getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

initialize(address,address,address,addre.details: OPERATOR_ROLE is not granted here: the admin grants it explicitly (see script/Deploy.s.sol).

params.manaBudget: Maximum Mana Coin mintable per epoch (0 freezes Mana minting).
params.pocBudget: Maximum POC mintable per epoch (0 freezes POC minting).

params.crystalBudget: Maximum Crystal mintable per epoch (0 freezes Crystal minting).
params.crystal_: Crystal proxy (this manager must also be granted its MINTER_ROLE).

params.potBudget: Maximum POT mintable per epoch (0 freezes POT minting).
params.pot_: POT proxy (this manager must also be granted its MINTER_ROLE).

mintCrystal(address,uint256).details: Reverts with UnknownToken(address(0)) until the Crystal is registered (initializeV2).

mintPot(address,uint256).details: Restricted to OPERATOR_ROLE. Reverts with UnknownToken until POT is registered (initializeV3).

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC-1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). Emits a {RoleRevoked} event if the calling account had `role` and this call successfully revoked it. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

setEpochBudget(address,uint256).details: Lowering a budget below what was already minted this epoch blocks further mints until the next one.

setEpochDuration(uint256).details: The current epoch keeps its start and its already-minted amounts; only its end moves.

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[ERC section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

OPERATOR_ROLE().notice: Role allowed to call mintPoc, mintMana, mintCrystal, mintPot and mintMonster.

UPGRADER_ROLE().notice: Role allowed to upgrade the implementation.

constructor.notice: Locks the implementation contract so it can never be initialized directly.

crystal().notice: Crystal proxy (zero until registered by initializeV2).

currentEpochStart().notice: Start timestamp of the epoch that contains the current block.

epochBudget(address).notice: Maximum amount of `token` mintable per epoch.

initialize(address,address,address,addre.notice: Initializes the proxy. Callable once. The first epoch starts at the current block.

initializeV2(address,uint256).notice: 1.1.0 setup: registers the Crystal token and its per-epoch budget. Callable once per proxy, by the         admin (a fresh deployment calls it right after `initialize`; an upgraded 1.0.0 proxy calls it after         the upgrade). Restricted so nobody else can register a token between those two transactions.

initializeV3(address,uint256).notice: 1.2.0 setup: registers the POT exchange token and its per-epoch budget. Callable once per proxy, by         the admin, right after `initialize` + `initializeV2` (fresh deployment) or after the upgrade.

items().notice: Items proxy this manager holds MINTER_ROLE on (no minting function yet).

mintCrystal(address,uint256).notice: Mints `amount` Crystal to `to`, within the Crystal epoch budget. Restricted to OPERATOR_ROLE.

mintMana(address,uint256).notice: Mints `amount` Mana Coin to `to`, within the Mana epoch budget. Restricted to OPERATOR_ROLE.

mintMonster(address).notice: Mints a new monster to `to`. Restricted to OPERATOR_ROLE.

mintPoc(address,uint256).notice: Mints `amount` POC to `to`, within the POC epoch budget. Restricted to OPERATOR_ROLE.

mintPot(address,uint256).notice: Mints `amount` POT (the exchange currency) to `to`, within the POT budget of the current epoch.

mintedInCurrentEpoch(address).notice: Amount of `token` already minted in the epoch that contains the current block.

pot().notice: POT proxy minted by this manager (zero before the 1.2.0 setup).

remainingEpochBudget(address).notice: Amount of `token` still mintable in the epoch that contains the current block.

setEpochBudget(address,uint256).notice: Sets the maximum amount of `token` mintable per epoch. Restricted to DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.

setEpochDuration(uint256).notice: Sets the epoch length in seconds (shared by both tokens). Restricted to DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.

version().notice: Version of this implementation, bumped by every upgrade.
